'''Corulag''' (pronounced /'kʊɹalæg/)<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> was a populated terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] in the [[Corulus system]] in the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]], part of the [[Ringali Shell]]. It was the endpoint of the [[Corulag-Jatir Hyperroute]]. The planet boasted urban sprawls with the underdeveloped areas filled with [[Bamboo/Legends|bamboo]] forests.

It was near the [[Ringali Nebula/Legends|Ringali Nebula]] and shared the sun [[Corulus]] with [[Solag]], [[Biolag]], and [[Garulag]].

==History==
[[File:CorulagSpace.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Corulag from space]]

Originally a colony of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="CatCW" />, Corulag was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] with a mostly [[Human/Legends|Human]] population with a few [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] and [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] as well. This planet was colonized when, under [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] domination, the Humans of Coruscant sent out [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]] to colonize distant worlds. These sleeper ships ended up throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], in locations such as Corulag, [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], [[Seoul 5]], [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], [[Argai]], [[Axum]], [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]], [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisia]], [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]], and many others.

The planet was an early member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and was the site of a battle in the [[First Great Schism]] in which [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Danzigorro Potts]] slew his own [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Jook-jook H'broozin]], who had joined the [[Legions of Lettow]], though other [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] escaped, including [[Blendri]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="JedivsSith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

The planet was known for its [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] races. It was the headquarters of [[Aether Hypernautics]], [[Danthe Artifice, Ltd.]], [[Gowix Computers]], [[Gwain Spices]], [[Korden Outfitting and Surveying]] and the [[Mansom Corporation]]. [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] developed the [[TIE Advanced x7/Legends|TIE/Ad x7]] at the [[Sienar Advanced Research Division]] on Corulag, the same facility from which [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] stole the [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']]{{'s}} engines. It was also home to [[Coreguard Security Services]], which provided security to other companies on the planet.

[[File:Corulag.png|thumb|left|200px|The Corulag cityscape]]

Around [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]], [[Haddius Korden]], a successful merchant from Corulag, turned his family business into Korden Outfitting and Surveying, which supplied a wide variety of equipment to colonists headed for the farthest frontiers of the known galaxy.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>

Near the end of the [[New Sith Wars]], the world was [[Battle of Corulag (New Sith Wars)|captured]] by the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. In [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]], five powerful families from Corulag called the [[Quintad/Legends|Quintad]] left Corulag to the backwater planet of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] where they turned the planet into the [[Coruscant of the Outer Rim]].

Before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Chief [[Scientist/Legends|Scientist]] [[Frexton]] of the [[Corulag Academy]] had kidnapped [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] adept [[Teela Panjarra]] to study the Force, so [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Vel Ardox]], [[Noro Zak]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] infiltrated the Academy in an attempt to rescue her. This was complicated by an attack of [[Bartokk]] assassins. Eventually, though, they were beaten, and the child was rescued from the Academy's nursery.

A longtime supporter of the Core Worlds, Corulag shrewdly aligned with Senator Palpatine during his rise to power.<ref name="The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Corulag remained loyal to the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, where it was represented by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Zafiel Snopps]]. Corulag, unlike other planets in the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]], was represented independently; all others were represented at that time by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]. 

When the New Order was declared, the Emperor rewarded its loyalty with high-ranking posts for many citizens and the founding of a major Imperial academy, second only to [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal’s]]. The academy created jobs, offered [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] training, and attracted industries tied to the Imperial war machine. In return, Corulag’s people upheld order in their system and hosted key institutions like the Corulag Academy and [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]]’ [[Sienar Advanced Research Division|Advanced Research Division]].<ref name="The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" />

[[File:CorulagLand.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Rebels raid a prison on Corulag.]]

After the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] took over, the planet's population was extremely loyal to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and its behavior was pointed out as model [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] behavior. The capital city of [[Curamelle/Legends|Curamelle]] was home to the [[Corulag Academy]], an Imperial military academy. Also during this time, Corulag was home to numerous prisons which held enemies of the Galactic Empire. The [[House of Citizens]] was still officially in power, being the lineal descendant of the ancient governments of Corulag through the millennia, though Zafiel Snopps was the de facto ruler and dictator as Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the world.

Corulag boasted orbital research stations over its surface on which important work on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] project was done. Rebel forces confirmed the project's existence after a successful [[Raid over Corulag|raid]] on these stations.<ref name="EaW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref> Under the Empire, Corulag was extremely influential, but after the death of Emperor Palpatine, the planet lost much of its influence.

The retreating Empire eventually abandoned Corulag.<ref name="JASB">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref> Due to Corulag's close ties to Palpatine's [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], few members of the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] were eager to provide aid to the world.<ref name="CatCW" />

Corulag capitulated to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] after the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]], though the populace was solidly anti-Vong. Corulag was the site of a [[Battle of Corulag (Yuuzhan Vong War)|battle]] between elements of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Second Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Second Fleet]] led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Traest Kre'fey]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], en route to an attack on Coruscant, and Yuuzhan Vong forces. Kre'fey and Antilles liberated the planet from the Yuuzhan Vong, and the collaborationist government was violently overthrown by furious citizens.<ref name="TUF" />

Corulag was the site of a [[Battle of Corulag|battle]] during the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. [[Oron Jaeger]] participated in the conflict, where he received a head wound.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'' says that Zafiel Snopps was the senator of the Bormea sector from 33 BBY to 19 BBY. Zafiel Snopps is merely the Imperial governor of Corulag in ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', set in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. In [[Star Wars Insider 70|''Star Wars Insider'' 70]], Arcel Mosbree is the senator. This is countered, nonetheless, by other sources that declare that Mon Mothma was the senator during that period.
